# CodeLegacy

> CodeLegacy is a web development company in Egypt serving the Gulf. We design and build custom websites, ecommerce stores, landing pages and SaaS platforms with Next.js and React, in Arabic and English.

- [Pricing](https://www.codelegacy.tech/en/pricing): starting prices and estimator
- [Our work](https://www.codelegacy.tech/en/lastprojects): portfolio of delivered websites
